engine: ES OVERNIGHT HIGH LONG — SIX-BAR ENTRY-ONLY PROOF
data: QuantConnect continuous ES minute data consolidated to 5-minute bars

test_definition.horizon: six completed 5-minute bars after the signal
test_definition.win: +1.0 signal ATR reached before -0.5 signal ATR
test_definition.neither_policy: reported separately and not counted as a win
test_definition.costs: not applicable to the signal-only excursion test

limitations: The source contains five-minute OHLCV and does not establish bid/ask cumulative delta, volume-at-price HVN/LVN, iceberg activity, or Level 3 queue position.
MFE and MAE are bar-based; when both thresholds occur in the same five-minute bar, their intrabar order is unknowable and is scored conservatively as a loss.
QuantConnect free Object Store writes were unavailable, so aggregate diagnostics were retained through debug metrics rather than a downloadable per-signal log.
conclusion: FAIL: the locked Overnight High long signal does not possess the proposed six-bar entry edge. Its 11.92% raw win rate and 0.907 MFE/MAE ratio are far below the proposed 60% and 1.8 thresholds. Do not attempt to repair this entry with money management, and do not add untested order-flow filters to the live dashboard.
